rules.name: LevelRejectedFromAbove
rules.description: Of the visits, at least a fraction F were upper-wick visits (the current close lies between the visit's body top and its high): short. Mirror: lower-wick visits (between its low and body bottom): long.

library_check.evidence: No rule classifies past bars at the current price level.

rules.name: LevelForwardDrift
rules.quote: What is typical of previous times this price was reached?
rules.description: Over visits at least H bars old, the mean H-bar move after the visit (close[i - H] - close[i]), divided by the current ATR, is at least +D: long; at most -D: short. No look-ahead because i >= H.
rules.pseudocode:
if (visit && i >= H) { s = s + (close[i - H] - close[i]); nf = nf + 1; }
long = nf >= minVisits && el_ge(s / nf, D * atr);

library_check.evidence: No rule measures what price did after earlier visits to the current level.

notes: The move is measured from the visit bar's close; measuring from the current close (the level) is the other reading.
M >= H keeps every visit's forward window strictly in the past.

rules.name: LevelThinAir
rules.quote: Pair with signals for direction (price relative to ma, momentum, candlestick patterns)
rules.description: At most Kthin visits in the window (price is in thin air), entered in the direction of the last J-bar move: long when close > close[J].
rules.sides: mirrored (the visit count is identical both sides)

library_check.evidence: The direction half is Momentum(J); the thin-air count has no library match. Kept as TRIAGE's pane-1 rule; it could equally be authored as a same-sided pane-2 count plus a Momentum placement.

rules.name: LevelBodyDominated
rules.description: At least a fraction F of the visits had the current close inside the visit's body.
rules.pseudocode:
if (visit && el_ge(close[0], minlist(open[i], close[i])) && el_le(close[0], maxlist(open[i], close[i]))) nb = nb + 1;
pass = enough && el_ge(nb, F * nv);

library_check.evidence: No rule classifies past bars at the current price level by body versus wick.

rules.name: LevelWasTrending
rules.description: The mean ADX(14) on the visit bars is at least T; negate for at most.
rules.pseudocode:
if (visit) sa = sa + adx[i];
pass = enough && el_ge(sa / nv, T);

complexity.reason: reads ADX's history at arbitrary depth

library_check.evidence: AdxBelowThreshold reads the current ADX only.

notes: adx[i] needs a mirrored ADX buffer N deep; zero-filled before the first evaluated bar (CLAUDE.md convention), so early visits read 0.

rules.name: LevelBigBars
rules.description: The mean range of the visit bars divided by the current ATR is at least R; negate for small.
rules.pseudocode:
if (visit) sr = sr + (high[i] - low[i]);
pass = enough && el_ge(sr / nv, R * atr);

library_check.evidence: BarRangeAtrMultiple / LargeBarCountInWindow test recent bars against ATR; nothing averages the bars at the current price level.

rules.name: LevelHighVolume
rules.description: The mean total ticks of the visit bars is at least R x the mean ticks over the last L bars; negate for low.
rules.pseudocode:
if (visit) sv = sv + (double)ticks[i];
pass = enough && el_ge(sv / nv, R * average((double)ticks, L));

library_check.evidence: VolumeAboveAverageMultiple compares the current bar's ticks with their average; nothing averages ticks over the visit set.

notes: Total ticks, not the up-tick `volume` series (EL_FEATURES: Volume is UpTicks); TRIAGE's 'same rule on volume'. Split from P1f-a to keep one measure per candidate.

primitives_to_inline.name: PriceVisitScan
primitives_to_inline.quote: What is typical of previous times this price was reached? Mostly wicks or bodies? Volume? Trending or not (adx?)? Big candles or small candles?
primitives_to_inline.description: A VISIT is a past bar i in M..N bars ago whose high-low range contains the current close. The scan returns the visit count and per-visit statistics for P1a-P1f; every rule needs at least K visits. A difference test, so back-adjustment does not affect it.

complexity.reason: a long window loop with per-visit accumulation

library_check.evidence: No rule scans history for bars containing the current price; NearAnyLevel tests three magnets, LevelTouchCount one pivot level.

notes: Reaches back N (plus H for P1b, plus ADX history for P1e); Max Bars Back must cover it.

resolutions.answer: HIGH candle = CLOSE above the 50-bar high (symmetric with LOW). Every bar between the two L's (H's) must be a C candle.
Level = a cluster of wick lows within a tolerance, built like the I2 support zone (not the most recent swing low).

Zone: scanning back N bars, the K+ most recent 1-bar swing lows all within X*ATR of each other, with std dev of those lows <= k*ATR; bottom = lowest of them; a close more than 0.5*ATR below the bottom kills it. #26 needs two distinct stacked zones. No pane-2 'near zone' condition for now.
A bar that is both a swing high and a swing low counts as both, ordered by bar direction: a green bar (close > open) is low-then-high, a red bar high-then-low.
The mirror order (high, low, high, low with the last two inside the first two) also counts.
Breakaway move = a run of consecutive bull bars each with range >= k*ATR; measured from the first run bar's open to the run's highest high.
Cancel the armed setup if a later bar trades back into the band. Add a window input W, counted from the wick bar, constrained W > Z.
'Fractal low length ~3' = swing strength 3 (three bars each side); the pullback must be at least 3 bars.
